name: South Rithwic Outpost
title: South Rithwic Outpost
summary: Another starter outpost destroyed by Martine in The First Strike (Brentsella, Girdweld the Shopkeeper, chickens). In the kit: the Life Stone and its two signs on the low ground (z 28) east of a three-storey cottage ringed by oaks, a stone shop and well to the west, and on a rise to the south-west (z 38) the 28 m ruined Empyrean monument tower (top z 65.9) among dark dead trees.

shots.standingOrder: Start with a leafy bush hiding the outpost's Life Stone, then truck slowly right until its sparkle and the cottage behind come clear in the low golden side-light; keep 3 m from the bush and the trees.
shots.notes: Reveal from occluder: starts with a 7 m leafy bush (SE of the Life Stone) hiding the outpost's Life Stone, holds, then trucks right ~14 m until the sparkle, the cottage and the monument tower on its rise behind come clear in raking golden side-light (0.74). LOS blocked in the first ~0.8 s of the edit window (until the reveal at t 4.7) is the lead-in by design.
